name: m28_main
notes: One objective field covering the array is assumed for every method. AOD row-wise is a lower bound on crossed-AOD throughput; all-parallel is an idealised ceiling, not a hardware model.

aod_field_sites.source: 1064 nm TeO2 AODs with 90 / 150 resolvable spots (sintec.sg/ao/497.html, read 2026-11-14); 1.06 um resolution cell at NA 0.5

inputs.steady_window: second half of each run (t_end / 2 to t_end)
